title: External File Storage: reject "." and ".." path segments
summary: External File Storage now rejects any path where a whole segment is "." or "..", for all operations and connectors, so calls like DeleteDirectory('A/B/..') no longer act on folder A. Dots inside names stay valid. Callers that pass relative segments now get an error.
key_points: CheckPath in External File Storage Impl. rejects whole "." or ".." segments with a new error
Stops connectors such as SharePoint from resolving relative segments and acting on the wrong folder
Dots inside names, such as v1..2.pdf, ..hidden or a., remain valid
Public API behavior change: try functions return false for such paths, so outside callers must pass normalized paths
New test codeunit 134754 File Storage Path Test covers the rejected and allowed cases
quote: Rejects a path when a whole segment is "." or "..", with a clear error.
